dialogue.content: (おはようございます。本日はよろしくお願いします。）
dialogue.English: (Good morning. I look forward to speaking with you today.)

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: Thank you. I look forward to it as well.

dialogue.content: （時間になったら開始させていただきますね。）
dialogue.English: (We'll get started once it's time.)

dialogue.content: 承知しました
dialogue.English: Understood.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。はじめにご年齢と性別、本日お話しになりたいことを教えて下さいますか？
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm your counselor. To begin, could you please tell me your age and gender, and what you'd like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 36歳女　お金に困っています
dialogue.English: I'm a 36-year-old woman. I'm having financial trouble.

dialogue.content: 教えて頂きありがとうございます。それは苦しいですよね。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that. That must be very difficult.

dialogue.content: どんなことに困っているか、もう少し詳しくお聞かせいただけますか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me a bit more about what you're struggling with?

dialogue.content: 離婚の協議中なのですが、児童扶養手当がもらえないです
dialogue.English: I'm in the middle of divorce negotiations, but I can't receive the child-rearing allowance.

dialogue.content: なるほど・・そのような状況なのですね。
dialogue.English: I see... so that's the situation you're in.

dialogue.content: 大変な状況でお疲れのことと思います。そんな中、お越し下さりありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: I imagine you must be exhausted from this difficult situation. Thank you for coming to speak with me today amidst all of that.

dialogue.content: 当然養育費も婚姻費ももらっていません
dialogue.English: Of course, I'm not receiving child support or spousal support either.

dialogue.content: 疲れました
dialogue.English: I'm tired.

dialogue.content: ええ・・そうですよね。。今のご状況について、こちらからいくつかお聞きしてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Yes... I can imagine. Would it be okay if I ask you a few questions about your current situation?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。ご相談者様は今働いていますか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. Are you currently working?

dialogue.content: 働いています
dialogue.English: Yes, I am working.

dialogue.content: ただ子どもが学童に行きたくないと言い出し
dialogue.English: But my child has started saying they don't want to go to after-school care.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。（聞いています、続けて下さいね。）
dialogue.English: I see. (I'm listening—please go on.)

dialogue.content: これ以上仕事の時間は減らしたくないですが、一人で家にいさせるのもどうなんだろうと悩んでいます
dialogue.English: I don't want to cut my work hours any further, but I'm worried about leaving them home alone.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。。お子様のことも心配ですよね。
dialogue.English: I understand. You must be worried about your child as well.

dialogue.content: 1年生なのでちょっとまだ心配です
dialogue.English: They're in first grade, so I'm still a bit worried.

dialogue.content: １年生となると、まだまだ１人でお家にいてもらうのは心配なお年頃ですよね。ちなみにお子様は何人いらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: Being in first grade, that's certainly an age where it's worrying to leave them home alone. By the way, how many children do you have?

dialogue.content: その子一人です
dialogue.English: Just that one child.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 夫さんとは今どんな感じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How are things with your husband now?

dialogue.content: （お答えできる範囲で大丈夫ですよ。）
dialogue.English: (You only have to share what you're comfortable with.)

dialogue.content: 今は全く会わせていません
dialogue.English: I'm not letting him see the child at all now.

dialogue.content: なるほど。。では、今はあなたと小学生のお子様２人暮らしという認識で合っていますか？
dialogue.English: I see. So, am I correct in understanding that you're currently living with your elementary school-aged child, just the two of you?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 仕事に育児と日々よくやってらっしゃいることと思います。その中で離婚協議中、さらにお金ももらえないとなると気を揉まれますよね。。
dialogue.English: I imagine you are doing a great job managing work and childcare every day. To be going through divorce negotiations on top of that, and not receiving any money, must be very stressful.

dialogue.content: 足を引っ張らないで欲しいです、ほんとに
dialogue.English: I just wish he wouldn't drag me down, really.

dialogue.content: もう別居して1年になります
dialogue.English: We've been separated for a year now.

dialogue.content: 児童扶養手当もらえないのはなんでなんでしょうか。おかしいと思います
dialogue.English: Why can't I get the child-rearing allowance? I think it's unfair.

dialogue.content: ええ、そのように思うのも無理ないですね。夫さんは離婚のことやお金のこと、どんな風におっしゃっていますか？
dialogue.English: Yes, it's understandable that you would feel that way. What does your husband say about the divorce and the financial matters?

dialogue.content: あちらはこちらが提示した金額に対して出したくないようです
dialogue.English: He seems unwilling to pay the amount I've proposed.

dialogue.content: 自分の子なのに
dialogue.English: Even though it's his own child.

dialogue.content: 本当にムカつきます
dialogue.English: It really infuriates me.

dialogue.content: 自分の子なのに・・・そう感じるのも最もです。
dialogue.English: "Even though it's his own child"... It's completely natural for you to feel that way.

dialogue.content: 前からそうでした
dialogue.English: He's always been like that.

dialogue.content: 細かくお金の使い方に口を出す割に自分は趣味やら好きなものに浪費して
dialogue.English: He would nitpick about how I spent money, but then he'd splurge on his own hobbies and things he liked.

dialogue.content: 矛盾もいいとこです
dialogue.English: It's the height of hypocrisy.

dialogue.content: あなたが相当な思いを抱えて、夫さんと過ごしてこられたことが伝わってきます。
dialogue.English: It sounds like you've been carrying a heavy burden while living with your husband.

dialogue.content: 児童扶養手当もひとり親としてもらえる権利があるのに・・ともどかしい思いですよね。
dialogue.English: It's frustrating, especially when you have a right to the child-rearing allowance as a single parent.

dialogue.content: 事実婚の知り合いは児童扶養手当もらってましたからね
dialogue.English: An acquaintance of mine in a common-law marriage was receiving the child-rearing allowance.

dialogue.content: パートナーいるのに
dialogue.English: Even though she has a partner.

dialogue.content: そういったお知り合いの方がいらっしゃるのですね。
dialogue.English: I see, you have an acquaintance in that situation.

dialogue.content: なんか世の中って不公平ですね
dialogue.English: It feels like the world is so unfair.

dialogue.content: そのように感じられますよね。。ちなみに、離婚成立していないから、児童扶養手当がもらえていない状況・・ということで合っていますか？
dialogue.English: It's understandable to feel that way. Just to confirm, is the reason you can't receive the child-rearing allowance because the divorce hasn't been finalized yet?

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 表記もわかりにくくて
dialogue.English: The wording is also confusing.

dialogue.content: 条件に、別居して1年以上経っているって書いてあったんですよ
dialogue.English: The conditions said that you qualify if you have been separated for over a year.

dialogue.content: でも結局離婚してないとだめだと
dialogue.English: But in the end, they said you have to be divorced.

dialogue.content: これからの為にお金貯めていきたいのに毎日の生活に必死です
dialogue.English: I want to save money for the future, but I'm just struggling to get by day to day.

dialogue.content: ええ、それは混乱しますよね。本当によく頑張っているのが伝わってきます。
dialogue.English: Yes, that would be confusing. I can really see how hard you're working.

dialogue.content: 離婚成立の見通しは今どんな感じでしょうか？差し支えない範囲で状況やお気持ちを教えていただけますでしょうか。
dialogue.English: What is the outlook for the divorce being finalized? If you don't mind, could you tell me about the situation and how you're feeling?

dialogue.content: 先程にもあった通り、養育費諸々お金のことで揉めてます
dialogue.English: As I mentioned earlier, we're arguing about child support and other financial matters.

dialogue.content: 調停しないと無理かもしれません
dialogue.English: It might be impossible without mediation.

dialogue.content: そうでしたね、重ねての質問になってしまい失礼しました。今はどのように夫さんとやりとりなさっていますか？
dialogue.English: That's right, I'm sorry for repeating the question. How are you communicating with your husband now?

dialogue.content: 文章のみのやりとりです
dialogue.English: We only communicate in writing.

dialogue.content: 弁護士さんにやりとりしてもらってます
dialogue.English: My lawyer is handling the communication.

dialogue.content: 教えていただきありがとうございます。さらに離婚調停となると費用もかかることですので、不安なお気持ちですよね。
dialogue.English: Thank you for telling me. I imagine you must be anxious, as divorce mediation would involve additional costs.

dialogue.content: もううんざりです
dialogue.English: I'm fed up with it all.

dialogue.content: 時間も労力も削られ・・と考えると、そのように感じますよね。
dialogue.English: Considering the time and energy it takes, it's natural to feel that way.

dialogue.content: あなたとしては、どんな風になるのが理想ですか？
dialogue.English: What would be the ideal outcome for you?

dialogue.content: もらえるものもらって、早く離婚したいです
dialogue.English: I want to get what I'm entitled to and get divorced quickly.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうですよね。。やりとりしている弁護士さんは、どのようにお話しされていますか？
dialogue.English: Yes, I understand. What has your lawyer been saying?

dialogue.content: そろそろ調停とか裁判を考えた方がいいかもしれない、とは言われています
dialogue.English: I've been told it might be time to consider mediation or court.

dialogue.content: なるほど・・あなたは調停することに対して、どのように考えられていますか？
dialogue.English: I see. How do you feel about going to mediation?

dialogue.content: 仕方ないのかなと最近は思ってます
dialogue.English: Lately, I've been thinking it might be unavoidable.

dialogue.content: そのようなお気持ちなのですね。早くすっきりさせたいお気持ちもあるのでは・・と感じましたが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see that's how you're feeling. I get the sense that you also want to resolve this quickly and move on—does that sound right?

dialogue.content: はい、それはもちろんあります
dialogue.English: Yes, of course.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。今お金に困っている、とのことでしたが、調停の費用についてのご不安や感じていることはおありでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I can imagine. You mentioned you're having financial trouble; do you have any anxieties or feelings about the cost of mediation?

dialogue.content: そうですね、ただでさえ日々の生活でお金が出ていきますから
dialogue.English: Yes, money is already tight with daily living expenses as it is.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうですよね。。物価高ですし、日々一生懸命やりくりされているのだろうと感じています。
dialogue.English: Yes, I understand. With rising prices, I'm sure you're working hard to make ends meet every day.

dialogue.content: あなたのご実家や周りに支援してくださる方はいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: Do you have family or anyone around you who can offer support?

dialogue.content: 実家は遠方なので頼れません
dialogue.English: My family lives far away, so I can't rely on them.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、お一人で家事に子育てに・・とよく頑張ってらっしゃいますね。
dialogue.English: I see. You're doing a remarkable job handling housework and childcare all by yourself.

dialogue.content: 弁護士さんに調停の費用のことなど、相談されてていますか？
dialogue.English: Have you discussed the costs of mediation and other matters with your lawyer?

dialogue.content: それは把握してます
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm aware of that.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 先ほどもお伝えしましたが、児童扶養手当はひとり親が受けられる権利がありますす。今まで行政の方にはご相談されたことはありますでしょうか？
dialogue.English: As I mentioned earlier, the child-rearing allowance is a benefit single parents are entitled to. Have you consulted with the local government office about this?

dialogue.content: はい。離婚が成立してからとのことです
dialogue.English: Yes. They said it's only available after the divorce is finalized.

dialogue.content: やっぱり早く離婚成立させるしかないですね
dialogue.English: I guess there's no choice but to finalize the divorce quickly.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。あなたなりに一生懸命情報収集をして、どうにかしようという思いが伝わってきますよ。
dialogue.English: I see. I can tell that you've been working hard to gather information and are trying to find a way to resolve this.

dialogue.content: なんとか乗り切ります
dialogue.English: I'll get through this somehow.

dialogue.content: 今日はこれで大丈夫です。ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: That's all for today. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: ええ、貴重なお話しを聞かせていただきありがとうございました。まずは離婚成立に向けて、弁護士さんと相談なさってみて下さいね。
dialogue.English: Of course. Thank you for sharing your story with me. For now, please try consulting with your lawyer about finalizing the divorce.

dialogue.content: はい、それでは失礼します
dialogue.English: Yes, I'll do that. Goodbye.

dialogue.content: これから学費のことや、習い事・・お金のことで不安に思うことは多くあると思います。抱え込まずに、誰かに話しをしたり、あなた自身も息抜きをしながらお過ごし下さいね。
dialogue.English: I'm sure there will be many financial worries ahead, like school fees and extracurricular activities. Please don't bottle it all up. Talk to someone, and make sure you take time for yourself to relax as well.

dialogue.content: （終了で大丈夫です、ありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (We can end here, thank you.)

dialogue.content: （こちらこそありがとうございました。勉強になりました。それでは終了させていただきますね。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you as well. This has been a great learning experience. We will end the session now.)
